translations.web: All things were made through him. Without him, nothing was made that has been made.
translations.bsb: Through Him all things were made, and without Him nothing was made that has been made.
translations.kjv: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.
translations.asv: All things were made through him; and without him was not anything made that hath been made.
